## Experimental groups
```{r display_groups}
sample_names <- strsplit(trimws(as.character(config["samples",])), "\\s+")[[1]]
group_file <- as.character(config["experiment_group_file",])

has_group_file <- (
  length(group_file) == 1 && !is.na(group_file) &&
  nzchar(group_file) && file.exists(group_file)
)

if (has_group_file) {
  groups <- read.table(group_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(groups) <- c("Group", "Sample")
  unassigned_samples <- setdiff(sample_names, groups$Sample)
  if (length(unassigned_samples) > 0) {
    groups <- rbind(
      groups,
      data.frame(
        Group = unassigned_samples,
        Sample = unassigned_samples,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
} else {
  groups <- data.frame(
    Group = rep("all_samples", length(sample_names)),
    Sample = sample_names,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

kable(groups, caption = "Experimental groups used for merging and peak calling") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = TRUE) %>% scroll_box(width = "100%")

```

```{r input_sequencing_files, eval=demult}
# If demultiplexed, show only the input file
name_raw_fasta <- strsplit(as.character(config["infiles",]), "/") %>% unlist(.)
l <- length(name_raw_fasta)
name_raw_fasta <- name_raw_fasta[[l]] %>% unlist(.)
name_raw_fasta <- gsub("\\.fastq(\\.gz)?$", "", as.character(name_raw_fasta))  %>% unlist(.) %>% .[1]

# Read FastQC data
fastqc_data_file <- paste0(dir,"/results/fastqc/raw/", name_raw_fasta, "_fastqc/fastqc_data.txt")

if (file.exists(fastqc_data_file)) {
  fastqc_data <- read_delim(fastqc_data_file, 
                            delim = "\t", 
                            skip = 2, 
                            n_max = 10,
                            show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  # Extract Total Sequences (row 4) and Sequence length (row 7)
  total_seqs <- fastqc_data$Value[4]
  seq_length <- fastqc_data$Value[7]
  
  # Create table with just "input" as name
  input_table <- data.frame(
    Sample = "input",
    `Total Sequences` = format(as.numeric(total_seqs), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
    `Sequence Length` = seq_length,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  kable(input_table, caption = "Input sequencing file summary") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = TRUE) %>% scroll_box(width = "100%")
}
```

```{r barcode_file, eval=demult}
# Read and parse barcode fasta file
barcode_file <- as.character(config["barcodes_fasta",])
barcode_lines <- readLines(barcode_file)

# Extract sample names (lines starting with >) and sequences (following lines)
sample_names <- c()
barcodes <- c()

for (i in seq_along(barcode_lines)) {
  if (grepl("^>", barcode_lines[i])) {
    # Remove the ">" prefix
    sample_names <- c(sample_names, sub("^>", "", barcode_lines[i]))
    # Get the sequence from the next line
    if (i < length(barcode_lines)) {
      barcodes <- c(barcodes, barcode_lines[i + 1])
    }
  }
}

# Create table
barcode_table <- data.frame(
  `Sample Name` = sample_names,
  `Barcode` = barcodes,
  check.names = FALSE
)

kable(barcode_table, caption = "Sample barcodes used for demultiplexing") %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = TRUE)
```


```{r demultiplexing_statistics, eval=demult, include=FALSE}
flexbar_log <- paste0(dir, "/results/demultiplex/flexbarOut.log")

if (file.exists(flexbar_log)) {
  flexbar_lines <- readLines(flexbar_log, warn = FALSE)
  last_integer <- function(line) {
    value <- str_extract(line, "[0-9]+\\s*$")
    as.numeric(str_trim(value))
  }

  read_file_rows <- grep("^Read file:", flexbar_lines)
  written_reads <- vapply(read_file_rows, function(row) {
    next_file <- read_file_rows[read_file_rows > row]
    block_end <- if (length(next_file) > 0) next_file[[1]] - 1 else length(flexbar_lines)
    written_line <- grep("^\\s+written reads", flexbar_lines[row:block_end], value = TRUE)
    if (length(written_line) == 0) return(0)
    last_integer(written_line[[1]])
  }, numeric(1))
  short_reads_by_file <- vapply(read_file_rows, function(row) {
    next_file <- read_file_rows[read_file_rows > row]
    block_end <- if (length(next_file) > 0) next_file[[1]] - 1 else length(flexbar_lines)
    short_line <- grep("^\\s+short reads", flexbar_lines[row:block_end], value = TRUE)
    if (length(short_line) == 0) return(0)
    last_integer(short_line[[1]])
  }, numeric(1))
  demultiplex_file_names <- basename(sub("^Read file:\\s*", "", flexbar_lines[read_file_rows]))
  demultiplex_sample_names <- demultiplex_file_names %>%
    str_remove("^flexbarOut_barcode_") %>%
    str_remove("\\.fastq\\.gz$")

  unassigned_index <- which(grepl("barcode_unassigned", flexbar_lines[read_file_rows]))
  unassigned_reads <- 0
  if (length(unassigned_index) > 0) {
    unassigned_reads <- written_reads[[unassigned_index[[1]]]]
  }

  processed_line <- grep("^Processed reads\\s+", flexbar_lines, value = TRUE)
  short_line <- grep("^\\s*finally skipped short reads", flexbar_lines, value = TRUE)
  processed_reads <- if (length(processed_line) > 0) last_integer(processed_line[[1]]) else NA_real_
  short_reads <- if (length(short_line) > 0) last_integer(short_line[[1]]) else NA_real_
  assigned_reads <- sum(written_reads) - unassigned_reads

  demultiplex_counts <- list(
    processed = processed_reads,
    assigned = assigned_reads,
    unassigned = unassigned_reads,
    short = short_reads
  )
  assigned_files <- demultiplex_sample_names != "unassigned"
  demultiplex_sample_stats <- data.frame(
    Sample = demultiplex_sample_names[assigned_files],
    Written = written_reads[assigned_files],
    Short = short_reads_by_file[assigned_files],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      RemovedPercent = if_else(
        Written + Short > 0,
        100 * Short / (Written + Short),
        NA_real_
      )
    )

  demultiplex_summary <- data.frame(
    Metric = c(
      "Assigned to a configured barcode",
      "Not assigned to any barcode",
      paste0("Removed below ", config["min_read_length",], " nt")
    ),
    Reads = c(assigned_reads, unassigned_reads, short_reads),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  demultiplex_summary$Percent <- if (is.na(processed_reads) || processed_reads == 0) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * demultiplex_summary$Reads / processed_reads)
  }
  demultiplex_summary$Reads <- format(
    demultiplex_summary$Reads,
    big.mark = ",",
    scientific = FALSE
  )

  print(
    kable(
      demultiplex_summary,
      caption = paste0(
        "Flexbar demultiplexing statistics (", format(processed_reads, big.mark = ","),
        " processed reads)"
      )
    ) %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = TRUE)
  )
} else {
  cat("\\n**Flexbar demultiplexing statistics were not available.**\\n")
}
```

```{r fastq_screen_read_data, eval = fastq_screen_enabled && file.exists(paste0(dir,"/results/fastqscreen_multi/fastqscreen_multiqc_data/multiqc_fastq_screen.txt"))}
# Read the FastQ Screen multiqc data
fastqscreen_file <- paste0(dir,"/results/fastqscreen_multi/fastqscreen_multiqc_data/multiqc_fastq_screen.txt")

# Read header line separately to extract column names
header_line <- readLines(fastqscreen_file, n = 1)
col_names_raw <- strsplit(header_line, "\t")[[1]]

# Read the data without column names
fastqscreen_data <- read_delim(fastqscreen_file, delim="\t", col_names = FALSE, skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Identify genome-specific columns (pairs of "counts" and "percentage")
# Structure: Sample, total_reads, [genome counts, genome percentage]*, No hits counts, No hits percentage
genome_cols <- col_names_raw[!col_names_raw %in% c("Sample", "total_reads", "No hits counts", "No hits percentage")]

# For each genome, we have two columns: "genome counts" and "genome percentage"
# Extract unique genome names by removing " counts" and " percentage" suffixes
genome_names <- unique(gsub(" (counts|percentage)$", "", genome_cols))

# Create clean column names by combining genome names with metric types
clean_col_names <- c("Sample", "total_reads")
for (genome in genome_names) {
  clean_col_names <- c(clean_col_names, paste0(genome, "_counts"), paste0(genome, "_percentage"))
}
# Add "No hits" columns at the end
clean_col_names <- c(clean_col_names, "NoHits_counts", "NoHits_percentage")

# Assign clean column names to the data
colnames(fastqscreen_data) <- clean_col_names

# Clean up sample names (remove _screen suffix if present)
fastqscreen_data$Sample <- gsub("_screen$", "", fastqscreen_data$Sample)

# Create table with only percentage columns for display
percentage_col_indices <- grep("percentage$", col_names_raw)
percentage_col_names <- col_names_raw[c(1, percentage_col_indices)]  # Sample + percentage columns
fastqscreen_report <- fastqscreen_data[, c(1, percentage_col_indices)]
```

## Adapter trimming

**Adapter Content Detection and Trimming:**

If FastQC reports "No adapter content found" in the raw files, this indicates that adapter sequences were not detected by FastQC's automated detection. However, adapter trimming is still performed using FLEXBAR with the adapter sequences specified in your configuration file. If no file is provided, a default file is used, which contains standard Illumina and eCLIP adapters.

The adapters are trimmed from the 3' end of the read (`--adapter-trim-end RIGHT`), with an allowed error of 0.1 (`--adapter-error-rate 0.1`). The adapter must overlap the read by at least 1nt (`--adapter-min-overlap 1`). Adapter trimming can be done in multiple cycles as specified by the user, here `r config["adapter_cycles",]` (adapterCycles, see configurations). Reads shorter than `r config["min_read_length",]` are discarded (min_read_length, see configurations).

UMIs are written into the read header with (`--umi-tags`). (If the data is from ENCODE, UMIs are already removed from the read and written to the beginning of the header. As `umi_tools dedup`, which is used here for deduplication, expects the UMI to be at the end of the read, encode: True can be specified to move the UMI from the beginning of the read header to the end (see configurations).)

```{r barcode_distances, out.width="100%", eval=FALSE}

                             barcode = barcodes_fasta[c(1:nrow(barcodes_fasta) %% 2 == 0),])

barcodes_found <- barcodes_found %>%
  rowwise %>%
  mutate( mismatch_0 = vcountPattern(barcode, barcodes_fasta$barcode, max.mismatch=0) %>% sum(),
          mismatch_1 = vcountPattern(barcode, barcodes_fasta$barcode, max.mismatch=1) %>% sum(),
          mismatch_2 = vcountPattern(barcode, barcodes_fasta$barcode, max.mismatch=2) %>% sum(),
          mismatch_3 = vcountPattern(barcode, barcodes_fasta$barcode, max.mismatch=3) %>% sum(),
          mismatch_4 = vcountPattern(barcode, barcodes_fasta$barcode, max.mismatch=4) %>% sum(),
          mismatch_5 = vcountPattern(barcode, barcodes_fasta$barcode, max.mismatch=5) %>% sum(),
          dist = case_when(mismatch_0 > 0 ~ 0,
                           mismatch_1 > 0 ~ 1,
                           mismatch_2 > 0 ~ 2,
                           mismatch_3 > 0 ~ 3,
                           mismatch_4 > 0 ~ 4,
                           mismatch_5 > 0 ~ 5,
                           ),
          # dist = factor(dist, levels = dist),
          barcode = factor(barcode, levels = barcode),
          dist = as.character(dist))  %>%
  arrange(dist)

head(barcodes_found)

  geom_col()+
  theme(text=element_text(size=50))+
  scale_fill_viridis_d()


ggplot(barcodes_found[ barcodes_found$dist != 0,], aes(x=barcode, y = log(n), fill = as.factor(dist)))+
  geom_col()+
  theme(text=element_text(size=50))+
```

```{r trim_read_numbers, eval=(!demult && trim)}
    "Trimmed reads" = format(as.numeric(fastqc_report_trimmed$`Total Sequences`), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
    check.names = FALSE
  ) %>% arrange(as.character(Sample))
}
```

### Adapter content before trimming {.tabset}

The plots show where FastQC detects adapter or homopolymer sequence in each sample. Adapter signal beginning early in the reads can indicate short inserts and possible overdigestion.

```{r adapter_content_before_trimming, results='asis'}
adapter_sample_titles <- function(paths) {
  basename(dirname(dirname(paths))) %>%
    str_remove("_fastqc$") %>%
    str_remove("^flexbarOut_barcode_") %>%
    str_remove("^trimmed_") %>%
    str_remove("_renamed$") %>%
    str_remove(fixed(".alignMir.non_chimeric.sort"))
}

adapter_before_dir <- if (qual_bc) {
  paste0(dir, "/results/fastqc/filtered")
} else {
  paste0(dir, "/results/fastqc/raw")
}

adapter_before <- sort(list.files(
  path = adapter_before_dir,
  pattern = "^adapter_content\\.png$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
))

if (length(adapter_before) == 0) {
  cat("\n**No FastQC adapter-content plots were found before trimming.**\n")
} else {
  adapter_before_titles <- adapter_sample_titles(adapter_before)

  for (i in seq_along(adapter_before)) {
    cat("\n#### ", adapter_before_titles[[i]], " {-}\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("![](", adapter_before[[i]], ")\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```

### {-}

```{r adapter_content_after_trimming, eval=(demult || trim), results='asis'}
cat("### Adapter content after trimming {.tabset}\n")

adapter_after <- sort(list.files(
  path = paste0(dir, "/results/fastqc/samples_after_demultiplexing_or_trimming"),
  pattern = "^adapter_content\\.png$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
))

if (length(adapter_after) == 0) {
  cat("\n**No FastQC adapter-content plots were found after trimming.**\n")
} else {
  adapter_after_titles <- adapter_sample_titles(adapter_after)

  for (i in seq_along(adapter_after)) {
    cat("\n#### ", adapter_after_titles[[i]], " {-}\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("![](", adapter_after[[i]], ")\n", sep = "")
  }
}

cat("\n### {-}\n")
cat("\n**Interpretation note:** If the only signals remaining after trimming are **poly(A)** or **poly(G)**, no library-adapter sequence remains. Poly(G) can arise in two-colour sequencing when short inserts lead sequencing beyond informative sequence and the signal drops; weak or absent signal is then called as G. Poly(A) can indicate RNA fragments that reach a transcript's poly(A) tail, for example when binding sites are close to the 3' end. These signals are not evidence that adapter trimming failed and generally cannot be resolved by additional adapter-trimming cycles, but they should be kept in mind when interpreting read length and downstream results.\n")
```

# Alignment

The genome annotation is indexed using `STAR --runMode genomeGenerate`. The merged file of chimeric reads is then aligned to the genome annotation using `STAR --runMode alignReads`. For STAR settings, see Configurations. The resulting BAM files are indexed using `samtools index`.

# Obtaining crosslinks

The deduplicated BAM files are then converted to BED files using `bedtools bamtobed`. The reads are shifted 1 nt upstream (5' direction) with `bedtools shift -m 1 -p -1` because the UV crosslink should be positioned 1 nt earlier.
\n
To allow visualisation in a genome browser, the 1nt crosslink bed file is also converted to a .bigWig file using `bedGraphToBigWig`. These bigWig files are then combined by experimental group; singleton groups reuse the sample bigWig directly.

```{r peak_calling_table, eval=peaks, results='asis'}
read_pureclip_result <- function(peak_file) {
  group <- sub("\\.bed$", "", sub("^pureclip_sites_", "", basename(peak_file)))
  status_file <- file.path(dirname(peak_file), paste0("pureclip_status_", group, ".txt"))
  status <- "completed"
  status_message <- "PureCLIP completed successfully."

  if (file.exists(status_file)) {
    status_lines <- readLines(status_file, warn = FALSE)
    status_value <- sub("^Status\\t", "", grep("^Status\\t", status_lines, value = TRUE))
    message_value <- sub("^Message\\t", "", grep("^Message\\t", status_lines, value = TRUE))
    if (length(status_value) > 0) status <- status_value[[1]]
    if (length(message_value) > 0) status_message <- message_value[[1]]
  }

  data.frame(
    Group = group,
    Peaks = length(readLines(peak_file, warn = FALSE)),
    Status = gsub("_", " ", status),
    Message = status_message,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

peaks_dir <- paste0(dir, "/results/peaks")
peak_files <- list.files(
  peaks_dir,
  pattern = "^pureclip_sites_.*\\.bed$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(peak_files) > 0) {
  peak_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(peak_files, read_pureclip_result))
  peak_summary <- peak_summary[order(peak_summary$Group), ]
  rownames(peak_summary) <- NULL
} else {
  peak_summary <- data.frame(
    Group = character(), Peaks = integer(), Status = character(),
    Message = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

cat("Number of peaks identified in each sample/group: \n\n")
```

# Quality overview

This overview summarizes the available quality-control measurements for each sample. Peak counts are calculated after group-level peak calling; when samples belong to a group, the group's peak count is therefore shown for every sample in that group. Gray cells indicate that the corresponding workflow step was not run. Duplication rate is the percentage of aligned reads removed by UMI-based deduplication.

```{r quality_overview_heatmap, dpi=100, fig.width=16, fig.height=13}
clean_report_sample <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_remove("_fastqc$") %>%
    str_remove("_screen$") %>%
    str_remove("^flexbarOut_barcode_") %>%
    str_remove("^trimmed_") %>%
    str_remove("_renamed$") %>%
    str_remove(fixed(".alignMir.non_chimeric.sort"))
}

removal_metric <- if (demult) {
  "Removed during demultiplexing/trimming"
} else {
  "Removed during trimming"
}
demultiplex_metrics <- if (demult) {
  c(
    "Reads assigned to sample barcode",
    "Reads not assigned to any barcode"
  )
} else {
  character()
}
qc_metrics <- c(
  "Sequencing quality",
  "rRNA",
  demultiplex_metrics,
  removal_metric,
  "Adapter content after trimming",
  "Median RNA length",
  "Uniquely mapping rate",
  "Duplication rate",
  "Number of crosslinks",
  "Number of peaks"
)
report_samples <- strsplit(trimws(as.character(config["samples",])), "\\s+")[[1]]
report_entities <- report_samples

qc_values <- data.frame(
  Entity = character(), Metric = character(), Value = numeric(),
  Label = character(), Status = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
add_qc_values <- function(entity, metric, value, label, status) {
  qc_values <<- bind_rows(
    qc_values,
    data.frame(
      Entity = entity, Metric = metric, Value = value,
      Label = label, Status = status, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
}
fastqc_module_status <- function(lines, module) {
  status_line <- grep(paste0("^>>", module, "\\t"), lines, value = TRUE)
  if (length(status_line) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  tolower(strsplit(status_line[[1]], "\\t")[[1]][[2]])
}
fastqc_qc_status <- function(status) {
  c(pass = "Good", warn = "Acceptable", fail = "Poor")[[status]]
}
median_fastqc_quality <- function(lines) {
  start <- grep("^>>Per sequence quality scores", lines)
  if (length(start) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  module_end <- grep("^>>END_MODULE", lines)
  module_end <- module_end[module_end > start[[1]]]
  if (length(module_end) == 0 || module_end[[1]] <= start[[1]] + 2) return(NA_real_)
  module <- lines[(start[[1]] + 1):(module_end[[1]] - 1)]
  module[[1]] <- sub("^#", "", module[[1]])
  quality_table <- read.delim(text = paste(module, collapse = "\n"), check.names = FALSE)
  quality <- as.numeric(quality_table[[1]])
  counts <- as.numeric(quality_table[[2]])
  if (length(counts) == 0 || sum(counts) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  quality[which(cumsum(counts) >= sum(counts) / 2)[[1]]]
}

# STAR mapping statistics
star_files_qc <- list.files(
  paste0(dir, "/results/aligned"),
  pattern = "\\.Log\\.final\\.out$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
star_mapped_counts <- numeric()
for (star_file in star_files_qc) {
  star_lines <- readLines(star_file, warn = FALSE)
  sample <- clean_report_sample(str_remove(basename(star_file), "\\.Log\\.final\\.out$"))
  unique_rate_line <- grep("Uniquely mapped reads %", star_lines, value = TRUE, fixed = TRUE)
  unique_count_line <- grep("Uniquely mapped reads number", star_lines, value = TRUE, fixed = TRUE)
  multi_count_line <- grep("Number of reads mapped to multiple loci", star_lines, value = TRUE, fixed = TRUE)
  if (length(unique_rate_line) > 0) {
    unique_rate <- as.numeric(str_remove(str_trim(sub(".*\\|", "", unique_rate_line[[1]])), "%$"))
    status <- if (unique_rate > 80) "Good" else if (unique_rate > 50) "Acceptable" else "Poor"
    add_qc_values(sample, "Uniquely mapping rate", unique_rate, sprintf("%.1f%%", unique_rate), status)
  }
  if (length(unique_count_line) > 0) {
    unique_count <- as.numeric(str_trim(sub(".*\\|", "", unique_count_line[[1]])))
    multi_count <- if (length(multi_count_line) > 0) {
      as.numeric(str_trim(sub(".*\\|", "", multi_count_line[[1]])))
    } else 0
    star_mapped_counts[[sample]] <- unique_count + multi_count
  }
}

# Final per-sample FastQC data
final_fastqc_dir <- if (demult || trim) {
  paste0(dir, "/results/fastqc/samples_after_demultiplexing_or_trimming")
} else if (qual_bc) {
  paste0(dir, "/results/fastqc/filtered")
} else {
  paste0(dir, "/results/fastqc/raw")
}
final_fastqc_summary <- file.path(final_fastqc_dir, "multiqc_data", "multiqc_fastqc.txt")
if (file.exists(final_fastqc_summary)) {
  final_fastqc <- read_delim(final_fastqc_summary, delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)
  final_fastqc$Sample <- clean_report_sample(final_fastqc$Sample)
  if ("median_sequence_length" %in% colnames(final_fastqc)) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(final_fastqc))) {
      median_length <- as.numeric(final_fastqc$median_sequence_length[[i]])
      status <- if (median_length > 40) "Good" else if (median_length >= 20) "Acceptable" else "Poor"
      add_qc_values(
        final_fastqc$Sample[[i]], "Median RNA length", median_length,
        paste0(round(median_length, 1), " nt"), status
      )
    }
  }
}

fastqc_data_files <- list.files(
  final_fastqc_dir,
  pattern = "^fastqc_data\\.txt$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
for (fastqc_file in fastqc_data_files) {
  fastqc_lines <- readLines(fastqc_file, warn = FALSE)
  sample <- clean_report_sample(basename(dirname(fastqc_file)))

  quality_status <- fastqc_module_status(fastqc_lines, "Per sequence quality scores")
  median_quality <- median_fastqc_quality(fastqc_lines)
  if (!is.na(quality_status) && quality_status %in% c("pass", "warn", "fail")) {
    quality_label <- if (is.na(median_quality)) {
      toupper(quality_status)
    } else {
      paste0("Q", round(median_quality, 1))
    }
    add_qc_values(
      sample, "Sequencing quality", median_quality,
      quality_label, fastqc_qc_status(quality_status)
    )
  }

  if (demult || trim) {
    adapter_status <- fastqc_module_status(fastqc_lines, "Adapter Content")
    if (!is.na(adapter_status) && adapter_status %in% c("pass", "warn", "fail")) {
      adapter_detected <- adapter_status != "pass"
      add_qc_values(
        sample, "Adapter content after trimming", NA_real_,
        if (adapter_detected) "Detected" else "None detected",
        if (adapter_detected) "Poor" else "Good"
      )
    }
  }
}

# FastQ Screen rRNA percentage; absent values remain Not run
if (fastq_screen_enabled && exists("fastqscreen_data")) {
  rrna_column <- grep("rRNA.*_percentage$", colnames(fastqscreen_data), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  if (length(rrna_column) > 0) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(fastqscreen_data))) {
      rrna <- as.numeric(fastqscreen_data[[rrna_column[[1]]]][[i]])
      status <- if (rrna < 2) "Good" else if (rrna < 10) "Acceptable" else "Poor"
      add_qc_values(
        clean_report_sample(fastqscreen_data$Sample[[i]]), "rRNA", rrna,
        sprintf("%.1f%%", rrna), status
      )
    }
  }
}

# Barcode assignment statistics from the Flexbar demultiplexing log
if (
  demult && exists("demultiplex_counts") &&
  exists("demultiplex_sample_stats") &&
  !is.na(demultiplex_counts$processed) && demultiplex_counts$processed > 0
) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(demultiplex_sample_stats))) {
    assigned_percent <- 100 * demultiplex_sample_stats$Written[[i]] /
      demultiplex_counts$processed
    add_qc_values(
      clean_report_sample(demultiplex_sample_stats$Sample[[i]]),
      "Reads assigned to sample barcode",
      assigned_percent,
      sprintf("%.1f%%", assigned_percent),
      "Informational"
    )
  }

  unassigned_percent <- 100 * demultiplex_counts$unassigned /
    demultiplex_counts$processed
  unassigned_status <- if (unassigned_percent < 10) {
    "Good"
  } else if (unassigned_percent <= 20) {
    "Acceptable"
  } else {
    "Poor"
  }
  for (sample in report_samples) {
    add_qc_values(
      sample,
      "Reads not assigned to any barcode",
      unassigned_percent,
      sprintf("%.1f%%", unassigned_percent),
      unassigned_status
    )
  }
}

# Fraction removed during demultiplexing/trimming or trimming alone
removal_status <- function(value) {
  if (value < 10) "Good" else if (value <= 20) "Acceptable" else "Poor"
}
if (demult && exists("demultiplex_sample_stats")) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(demultiplex_sample_stats))) {
    removed <- demultiplex_sample_stats$RemovedPercent[[i]]
    if (!is.na(removed)) {
      add_qc_values(
        clean_report_sample(demultiplex_sample_stats$Sample[[i]]),
        removal_metric, removed, sprintf("%.1f%%", removed),
        removal_status(removed)
      )
    }
  }
} else if (trim && file.exists(final_fastqc_summary)) {
  pretrim_dir <- if (qual_bc) {
    paste0(dir, "/results/fastqc/filtered")
  } else {
    paste0(dir, "/results/fastqc/raw")
  }
  pretrim_summary <- file.path(pretrim_dir, "multiqc_data", "multiqc_fastqc.txt")
  if (file.exists(pretrim_summary)) {
    pretrim_qc <- read_delim(pretrim_summary, delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      transmute(
        Sample = clean_report_sample(Sample),
        Before = as.numeric(`Total Sequences`)
      )
    trimming_qc <- final_fastqc %>%
      transmute(
        Sample,
        After = as.numeric(`Total Sequences`)
      ) %>%
      inner_join(pretrim_qc, by = "Sample") %>%
      mutate(Removed = 100 * (Before - After) / Before)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(trimming_qc))) {
      removed <- trimming_qc$Removed[[i]]
      add_qc_values(
        trimming_qc$Sample[[i]], removal_metric, removed,
        sprintf("%.1f%%", removed), removal_status(removed)
      )
    }
  }
}

# UMI-based duplication and crosslink counts
umi_log_files <- list.files(
  paste0(dir, "/results/aligned"),
  pattern = "\\.Aligned\\.sortedByCoord\\.out\\.duprm\\.log$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
if (dedup && length(umi_log_files) > 0) {
  for (umi_log in umi_log_files) {
    umi_lines <- readLines(umi_log, warn = FALSE)
    input_line <- grep("INFO Reads: Input Reads:", umi_lines, value = TRUE, fixed = TRUE)
    output_line <- grep("INFO Number of reads out:", umi_lines, value = TRUE, fixed = TRUE)
    if (length(input_line) == 0 || length(output_line) == 0) next
    input_reads <- as.numeric(str_extract(input_line[[1]], "[0-9]+$"))
    output_reads <- as.numeric(str_extract(output_line[[1]], "[0-9]+$"))
    sample <- clean_report_sample(str_remove(
      basename(umi_log),
      "\\.Aligned\\.sortedByCoord\\.out\\.duprm\\.log$"
    ))
    if (input_reads > 0) {
      duplication_rate <- 100 * (input_reads - output_reads) / input_reads
      duplication_status <- if (duplication_rate < 20) "Good" else if (duplication_rate < 40) "Acceptable" else "Poor"
      add_qc_values(
        sample, "Duplication rate", duplication_rate,
        sprintf("%.1f%%", duplication_rate), duplication_status
      )
    }
    crosslink_status <- if (output_reads > 20000) "Good" else if (output_reads >= 10000) "Acceptable" else "Poor"
    add_qc_values(
      sample, "Number of crosslinks", output_reads,
      scales::comma(output_reads), crosslink_status
    )
  }
} else if (!dedup && length(star_mapped_counts) > 0) {
  for (sample in names(star_mapped_counts)) {
    crosslinks <- star_mapped_counts[[sample]]
    status <- if (crosslinks > 20000) "Good" else if (crosslinks >= 10000) "Acceptable" else "Poor"
    add_qc_values(
      sample, "Number of crosslinks", crosslinks,
      scales::comma(crosslinks), status
    )
  }
}

# Repeat each group-level peak count for every sample assigned to that group
if (peaks && exists("peak_summary") && nrow(peak_summary) > 0) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(peak_summary))) {
    peak_group <- as.character(peak_summary$Group[[i]])
    peak_count <- peak_summary$Peaks[[i]]
    status <- if (peak_count > 10000) "Good" else if (peak_count >= 1000) "Acceptable" else "Poor"
    group_samples <- unique(as.character(groups$Sample[groups$Group == peak_group]))
    if (length(group_samples) == 0 && peak_group %in% report_samples) {
      group_samples <- peak_group
    }
    for (sample in intersect(group_samples, report_samples)) {
      add_qc_values(
        sample, "Number of peaks", peak_count,
        scales::comma(peak_count), status
      )
    }
  }
}

qc_heatmap <- expand_grid(Entity = report_entities, Metric = qc_metrics) %>%
  left_join(qc_values, by = c("Entity", "Metric")) %>%
  mutate(
    Status = replace_na(Status, "Not run"),
    Label = replace_na(Label, "Not run"),
    Entity = factor(Entity, levels = report_entities),
    Metric = factor(Metric, levels = rev(qc_metrics)),
    Status = factor(
      Status,
      levels = c("Good", "Acceptable", "Poor", "Informational", "Not run")
    )
  )

quality_heatmap <- ggplot(qc_heatmap, aes(x = Entity, y = Metric, fill = Status)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), size = 5.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Good" = "#8BCB88",
      "Acceptable" = "#F2CF66",
      "Poor" = "#E88B8B",
      "Informational" = "#FFFFFF",
      "Not run" = "#D9D9D9"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "QC status") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 15),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(quality_heatmap)
ggsave(
  filename = paste0(plots_dir, "/Quality_overview.pdf"),
  plot = quality_heatmap,
  width = max(12, length(report_entities) * 1.8),
  height = 13
)
```

The color coding uses the following tentative thresholds:

| Measurement | Good (green) | Acceptable (yellow) | Poor (red) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Sequencing quality | FastQC PASS | FastQC WARN | FastQC FAIL |
| Adapter content after trimming | No adapter content detected | Not used | Adapter content detected |
| Median RNA length | >40 nt | 20 to 40 nt | <20 nt |
| rRNA | <2% | 2% to <10% | >=10% |
| Reads not assigned to any barcode | <10% | 10% to 20% | >20% |
| Uniquely mapping rate | >80% | >50% to 80% | <=50% |
| Removed during demultiplexing/trimming or trimming | <10% | 10% to 20% | >20% |
| Duplication rate | <20% | 20% to <40% | >=40% |
| Number of crosslinks | >20,000 | 10,000 to 20,000 | <10,000 |
| Number of peaks | >10,000 | 1,000 to 10,000 | <1,000 |

**Interpretation notes:**

- These cutoffs are an initial approach and may be adjusted in future versions as more reference datasets become available.
- The crosslink and peak-count thresholds are intended for organisms with genomes approximately the size of the human or mouse genome. For substantially smaller or larger genomes, their color coding should not be interpreted as a meaningful quality assessment.
- White cells are reserved for informational values, and gray cells indicate that a workflow step was not run.
